claims.assertion: Mari says Etorthan auditors searched hundreds of orbital ships and scheduled Toleka and Saska 1 for inspection; Alenym and Nai’shara refused boarding.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Alenym shut Taygetan muon communications to prevent pressure; internal ship links and internet remained. Muon pulses reportedly travel faster than light.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: They use coded muon-neutrino or gravity pulses.

claims.assertion: Mari says the Federation restricts Taygetan travel and contact, suspended extractions pending approval, and withdrew funding, leaving her channel and donations to support the group.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
